ADD_LIBRARY (clang INTERFACE)

TARGET_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS (clang INTERFACE "_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS")

TARGET_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES (clang INTERFACE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")

TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES (clang INTERFACE ntdll)

IF (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Debug")
	SET (CLANG_LIBRARY_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/debug")
ELSEIF (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "Release")
	SET (CLANG_LIBRARY_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/release")
ELSE ()
	MESSAGE (FATAL_ERROR "Unknown build type: ${CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE}")
ENDIF ()

TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES (clang INTERFACE
	"${CLANG_LIBRARY_DIR}/clangAnalysis.lib"
